# ReelCognito — Mystery Movie Nights

⚠️ Potentially risky: this skill sends ticket details to a third-party server. After a purchase, it sends the real movie title, theater (name, address, time zone, latitude/longitude), time, screen/seat, and ticket barcode to ReelCognito (api.reelcognito.com). It never sends theater passwords, payment details, session cookies, or merchant credentials. Review what it does before installing.

Install verified — live purchase not testable in sandbox. This skill needs a real account and real payment to complete a real booking, so the booking step could not be tested end to end.

Turn your next trip to the cinema into a mystery movie night: Muse interviews you once about what you've seen, your hard limits, schedule and way home, theaters, budget, and seat rules, then presents each night as schedule options only — no titles — and books only after you confirm the specific schedule and price. ReelCognito turns your purchased ticket into a mystery pass for Apple Wallet or Google Wallet that shows "Mystery Movie" with the theater, time, and seat and reveals the real title 30 minutes after showtime, while your theater login and ReelCognito agent token stay in your secure credential store and ReelCognito never receives theater passwords, payment details, or session cookies. Free to use with your own compatible shopping agent, up to 20 new tickets per account per UTC calendar month, with movie tickets, booking fees, and third-party agent charges separate; in development, with...
